note: THE economy table (PLAN.md 1.4 / F3). Prices are dollars at CS 1.6's own numbers for the guns (user 2026-10-12: "yes, please divide the number"; they were yen at ten times that until then, and a v1 profile's balance is divided on load: SaveMigrations) (the damage is CS 1.6's too, user 2026-10-08).
